description: Experimental and numerical modeling of structure-soil-structure interaction on liquefiable soils and effects of mitigation in urban settings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Shideh Dashti, University of Colorado Boulder (colorado.edu). This research integrates experimental and numerical methods in geotechnical and structural engineering to investigate the behavior of nonlinear, similar and dissimilar buildings on liquefiable soils in the context of building performance. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-f11m-d683. Keywords: soil-structure interaction; structure-soil-structure interaction; seismic coupling; liquefaction; finite element analysis; numerical modeling; centrifuge modeling; urban liquefaction.. Published 2021-03-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
